sentences.text:
This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of Cr.P.C.).
2.

The applicant is in custody since 21.12.2022 in connection with Crime No.664/2022 registered at P.S.- Bargi District Jabalpur (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 363, 376, 376(3) of IPC and Section 3, 4 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story in brief is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrative sexual assault on minor prosecutrix aged 12 years.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 21.12.2022 and trial is still not over.
It is also urged that till today only NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37019 2 MCRC-29471-2025 four whiteness have been examined and 15 witnesses remains to be examined.
After referring to testimony of prosecutrix's monther, it is urged that prosecutrix was major on the date of incident.
Further, it is also not established from evidence on record that sample of the applicant was sealed on the spot.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on bail pending the trial.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.
6. Learned counsel for the objector submits that he has no objection, if the applicant is released on bail.
7. In the instant case, on the date of incident age of prosecutrix was approximately 12 years and DNA report is positive.
Hence, having regard to overall evidence available on record, no case for grant of bail is made out.
9. Hence, application filed by the applicant is dismissed.

10. However, just for expeditious disposal of the case, S.P., Jabalpur is directed to ensure that witnesses summoned by the trial Court are kept present on the date fixed by the trial Court and if the witnesses are not kept present on the date fixed by the trial Court, then, SP, Jabalpur shall be personally liable for the same and further, S.P. Jabalpur shall also ensure that all the witnesses are kept present for examination before trial Court within a period of 6 months from the date of receipt of copy of this order and trial Court shall fix the date accordingly.
11. Registry is directed to forward a copy of this order to the concerned S.P. NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37019 3 MCRC-29471-2025 12.
Let a copy of this order be also given to the Government Advocate for necessary compliance.
